verdict.rationale: Highnote documents 'Collaborative authorization' letting developers approve/decline transactions in real time based on custom business logic (highnote-docs-7), and separately documents webhooks/notifications configuration (highnote-docs-12) and a test environment for simulating real-time authorizations (highnote-docs-11, highnote-docs-26). However, none of the evidence specifies the network time budget the endpoint must respond within, nor a documented timeout/fallback decision the developer controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the response time window, and a documented fallback (approve/decline default) behavior on timeout.
